title.text: Material QEMU Deploy Assistant: one-click VirtualBox and VMware hosting

n1.text: Deploy wizard. Pick VirtualBox or VMware (only detected ones are enabled), take the latest verified appliance OVA or a local file, name the instance, set CPUs, memory and the bridged adapter, then Deploy. Try clicking the hypervisor cards. Not built yet: Docker host target, USB and Raspberry Pi flashing.

n2.text: Deploying. Real phases from the app: download, SHA-256 check, import, configure, start, wait for the appliance serial report, health check. Toggle the Ready tweak to see the success screen with the LAN link and first-run setup code.

n3.text: A failed deployment takes over the screen and stays until dismissed. It shows the exact failing command, exit code and the last real output lines, plus recovery actions. Values here are illustrative only.

n4.text: Instance manager. Lists only instances this app created: hypervisor, version, health and link, with start, stop, restart, open, copy link and remove. Health is checked live, never assumed. Click a row's Stop/Start to try it.

n5.text: Remove super confirmation. Names the exact instance and what is deleted. Turn both keys to unlock the full-range slider; it pulses while moving and plays a separate completion animation at 100%. Emergency exit and Esc cancel and return focus to the Remove button. Try turning the keys and sliding.
